{{Quote|Talus and Tralus are called the Double Worlds because they are just the same size as each other. They orbit around each other. Centerpoint Station is in the balance point. the barycenter, between Talus and Tralus.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
'''Tralus''' was the sister [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Together, they were known as the [[Double Worlds|Twin Worlds]]. Both shared the same [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around [[Centerpoint Station]]. Tralus was quite hospitable to most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] due to its many climates.

==History==
[[File:UndergroundRoyalSelonianCityRe.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An underground Selonian city on Tralus]]
Tralus was home to [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] and [[Mining/Legends|miners]], but it was also associated with the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]]: [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] was born and raised here, and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] father [[Jonash Solo|Jonash]] seemed to have spent his earliest childhood on Tralus.

Only [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], an underground [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on Tralus, the headquarters of General [[Weir/Legends|Weir]], was [[Mission to Tralus|discovered and destroyed]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], but only after Weir had tortured [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] to death.

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], it was the location of the [[Battle of Tralus (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] between rival [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] [[Josef Grunger]] and [[Danetta Pitta]].

During the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], the [[Tralus and Talus Liberation Party]] advocated independence for both worlds. In the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], it was the location of the opening [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]]. It was later [[Blockade of Corellia|blockaded]]. [[Sadras Koyan]] was its head of state.
